from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,signal,json,tempfile
repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe');base='f9a68e8839d8c942566788f0a942b2813142a8d8'
def git(*a):return subprocess.run(['git',*a],cwd=repo,check=True,text=True,capture_output=True).stdout.strip()
if git('rev-parse','HEAD')!=base:raise SystemExit('AUTHORITY_CHANGED')
code=r'''
import asyncio,json,tempfile,os
from pathlib import Path
from tools.ats_capture_snapshot import capture
from tools.ats_review_answer_matches import build_review_with_verified_matches
url="https://jobs.lever.co/ethena/f85bcfd1-8d2c-4cf5-a6ab-1c8ddab14c65/apply"
async def main():
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="jobpipe-ats-snapshot-") as folder:
  path=Path(folder)/"fields.json"
  diagnostic=await capture(url,path)
  data=json.loads(path.read_text())
  batch=build_review_with_verified_matches(data,{"full_name","email","phone"},[],"Ethena")
  keys={"type","question","label","required","ambiguous"}
  assert all(set(item)==keys for item in data)
  assert (path.stat().st_mode & 0o777)==0o600
  assert batch["submission"]=="not_attempted"
  assert diagnostic["auth"]=="not_attempted" and diagnostic["form_fill"]=="not_attempted"
  assert diagnostic["submission"]=="not_attempted"
  print(json.dumps({"http_status":diagnostic["http_status"],"snapshot_field_count":len(data),"review_items":batch["review_item_count"],"verified_profile_candidates":len(batch["verified_candidates"]),"snapshot_mode":"0600","metadata_only":True,"auth":"not_attempted","fill":"not_attempted","submission":"not_attempted"},sort_keys=True))
asyncio.run(main())
'''
p=subprocess.Popen([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-c',code],cwd=repo,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,start_new_session=True)
try:o,e=p.communicate(timeout=85)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
 os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL);raise SystemExit('TIMEOUT')
print('EXIT',p.returncode,'OUTPUT',o[-5000:],'ERROR',e[-900:],flush=True)
if p.returncode:raise SystemExit('LIVE_CAPTURE_FAILED')
r=json.loads(o)
assert r['http_status']==200 and r['snapshot_field_count']>0 and r['review_items']>0
assert r['metadata_only'] and r['submission']=='not_attempted'
assert git('rev-parse','HEAD')==base
print('LIVE_PRIVATE_SNAPSHOT_REVIEW_PIPELINE_VERIFIED',flush=True)
